fusions.name: Wet Coat Shake
fusions.desc: Sprays every enemy within 2 tiles and deals 4 water damage, with a 40% chance each to leave it [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Soft-Mouthed Retrieve
fusions.desc: Springs at a target up to 5 tiles away and deals 9 water damage, up to 1.5 times that at full range. Usable only on a target carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Shrug It Off
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Water off the Back
fusions.desc: Every time something other than fire hurts you, you regain 3 stamina, once every 4 seconds. You have 10% water resistance.
